sources.title: Unicode Standard 17.0.0: UTF-8
sources.inspection_note: Unicode 17.0.0 §3.9.3 D92 and Tables 3-6/3-7; §3.10 D95. Each Unicode scalar maps to 1–4 unsigned bytes; UTF-8 serialization preserves byte order. Lone surrogates are not valid UTF-8 text. Supports byte coverage reasoning, not meaningful generated text.

sources.title: Tokenizers ByteLevel implementation
sources.authority_reason: Maintainer-owned Hugging Face Tokenizers implementation at the installed release tag.
sources.inspection_note: Tokenizers v0.23.2 byte_level.rs lines 15–38, 43–47, 94–96, 120–152, 163–178. Byte-to-visible-character mapping includes each u8 exactly once. alphabet returns all mapping values. ByteLevel uses GPT2 regex pre-splitting, prepends a space only when add_prefix_space is true, converts all UTF-8 bytes to mapped characters, and decoder concatenates inverse bytes before from_utf8_lossy. Thus valid encode→decode text preserves unseen characters; arbitrary model ID strings can still decode with replacement characters.

sources.title: Tokenizers BPE trainer implementation
sources.authority_reason: Maintainer-owned Hugging Face Tokenizers implementation at the installed release tag.
sources.inspection_note: Tokenizers v0.23.2 trainer.rs lines 295–360, 457–549. Adds specials first; inserts initial alphabet regardless of corpus occurrence, sorted for deterministic IDs unless alphabet limiting applies; counts adjacent pairs within tokenized words; chooses highest pair counts and concatenates symbols; stops at target vocabulary, empty queue, or min frequency. Budget below initial alphabet can still produce a larger actual initial vocabulary. BPE fitting modifies vocabulary/merges, not a language model.

sources.title: Tokenizers BPE encoding implementation
sources.authority_reason: Maintainer-owned Hugging Face Tokenizers implementation at the installed release tag.
sources.inspection_note: Tokenizers v0.23.2 model.rs merge_word lines 465–548. Encoding first obtains symbol IDs from saved vocabulary and calls word.merge_all with stored merges; it does not refit a language model.

sources.title: Tokenizers Python API bindings
sources.authority_reason: Maintainer-owned Hugging Face Tokenizers implementation at the installed release tag.
sources.inspection_note: Tokenizers v0.23.2 Python bindings tokenizer.rs save lines 828–840, encode 1182ff, decode 1526–1548, train_from_iterator 1765–1844. Save serializes tokenizer JSON; encode returns Encoding with tokens/IDs; decode maps IDs to text with special-token skipping default; train_from_iterator accepts strings/list batches and hands them to tokenizer trainer. No model optimizer or neural parameters are involved.
